name: stage4_baselines
registered: 2026-09-26, before any Stage-4 model was trained (code smoke tests on tiny subsamples excepted; their outputs are discarded)
purpose: add the two strongest published competitors for unobserved-station post-processing (Lakatos 2026, arXiv:2609.07512) to the Stage-2 (German RL18) and Stage-3 (EUPPBench) new-station benchmarks; baselines only, no superiority hypothesis
folds: identical to Stage 2 / Stage 3 (results/stage{2,3}/folds_{random,spatial}.csv); held-out stations excluded from all fitting steps (normalisation, training, early stopping)

seeds.note: modest (3) seeds for time; random-fold comparisons with existing networks use the same seeds 0-2 of those networks (fair 3-seed ensembles); 10-seed numbers of existing networks are shown for reference only

drn_lak.description: Lakatos-style DRN: 1 hidden layer MLP, no station embedding, Gaussian output (mu, |sigma|), CRPS loss. Architecturally the same model class as nn_noemb; differs in hyperparameters and inputs, which are matched to Lakatos 2026 Table A2 (T2M, extended feature set) and Table A1
drn_lak.inputs: all ensemble mean and sd predictors of the dataset (German: 34 as in Stage 2; EUPPBench: 32 as in Stage 3) + lat, lon, alt, orog + sin(2*pi*doy/365.25), doy, month (+ lead one-hot for EUPPBench). No alt-orog and no land-use (Lakatos does not use them). Inputs z-scored with training-station fit-period statistics
drn_lak.activation: ReLU (not stated in paper; Rasp & Lerch default)
drn_lak.early_stopping: as Stage 2/3 (paper does not state epochs)
drn_lak.deviation_from_paper: no rolling daily refit (paper: rolling 3283-day window ~ all history; here one fit on the full fit period); predictor sets are those of our datasets

gnn_geo.description: GNN-Geo as in Lakatos 2026 Sec. 3.2.2: GraphSAGE, mean aggregation, graph from haversine distance, edge iff distance <= 50 km (altitude ignored), binary, undirected, no self-loops, isolated nodes allowed (they use only the root term)
gnn_geo.layer: h_i = ReLU(W_root x_i + W_nb mean_{j in N(i), available at t} x_j + b); dropout; linear -> (mu, |sigma|)
gnn_geo.time_slice: German: one date; EUPPBench: one (initialisation, lead) pair
gnn_geo.why_more_epochs: an epoch has only ~12 (German) to ~70 (EUPPBench) optimiser steps with 256-slice batches, vs ~300-430 for the row-level networks
gnn_geo.graph_during_training: training stations of the fold only (held-out stations are not nodes during fit or early stopping)
gnn_geo.graph_at_test: all stations (training + held-out); a held-out node aggregates the observation-free forecast features of all stations within 50 km; loss/scores only on held-out nodes
gnn_geo.missing: a (slice, station) with missing observation has no forecast row in our files; such nodes are removed from that slice (not aggregated, not scored)
gnn_geo.deviation_from_paper: no rolling refit (paper used a 361-day rolling window for GNN-Geo); unobserved stations are not in the training graph (stricter than a fixed all-station graph)

existing_methods_reused: raw_ensemble_gauss, emos_gl, emos_bst_gl, nn_unk, nn_knn, nn_noemb, nn_attr, nn_hybrid, nn_hybrid_res from results/stage{2,3}/preds (unchanged)
metrics: as Stage 2/3: mean Gaussian CRPS over held-out rows pooled over folds (seed-ensemble: mean of mu and sigma), MAE, RMSE, cov80/90, PIT RI, spread-skill, bias, per-fold, per-lead, distance bins, single-seed mean+-sd; EUPPBench 51-member test inputs only (no 11-member sensitivity)

tests.method: DM on daily (per-initialisation) mean CRPS differences, Newey-West lag 5; 7-day moving-block bootstrap 10000 reps; BH q=0.05 within each (dataset, fold type) family
tests.claims: none; these are baselines. Results are reported whatever they are

compute: local 8-core CPU box only; <=2 worker processes x 4 torch threads; resumable per (method, fold, seed)
